definitions.sourceDeclared: Existing application code declares target; current availability, operation necessity and route unverified.
definitions.seedCandidate: Navigation/probe/verification metadata observation seed; not reviewed allowlist.
definitions.runtimeObserved: Prior anonymous resource attempt including cancellations; HTTP 200 proves only that response for that sample.
definitions.officialStaticReference: Exact reference in official login HTML or directly referenced script; reviewed only for anonymous diagnostic static followup.
definitions.historicalNxDomain: A and AAAA returned rcode 3 in reused old evidence; not fresh DNS or proof host is permanently retired.
definitions.unknownDynamic: Origin chosen by page, redirect or response; exact reviewed target not derivable from repository.

scopeFindings.finding: Default merges all route and verification candidate hosts; complete batch validation rejects any failed candidate. Correct for true required targets; promoting the unreviewed union as mandatory for every operation is incorrect.
examples: kuaishou captcha.kuaishou.com and sec.kuaishou.com are historical NXDOMAIN verification candidates, absent from fixed collector calls
douyin www.douyin.com is optional site navigation, absent from fixed profile requests
bilibili geetest alternatives are not fixed nav/stat dependencies
scopeFindings.handling: Keep per-request strict denial. Scope must cover actual active operations and page dependencies; an attempted unknown host cannot be allowed merely by calling it optional.

scopeFindings.finding: catalogReviewed=false currently prevents production permission. Do not solve availability by just changing true or omitting failed evidence without changing the reviewed scope.
Default expands both IPv4/IPv6. Actual family must be constrained and proven; URL or successful A does not justify IPv6.

Existing page may stay on another first-party route with active background resources; API-only scopes are incomplete. Concurrent operations cannot silently replace one account scope and lose old page coverage.

Dynamic avatar/cover images load in shell default Session. Account Cookie partition is separate, but signed URL may be sensitive. These are outside account guard and should not become mandatory probe dependencies.
